section.description: Platforms designed to optimize processes and increase efficiency in critical sectors such as compliance, legal, HR, agriculture, logistics, and healthcare.

pcont.title: PCONT
pcont.headline: Turn Contract Management into a Competitive Advantage
pcont.desc: Imagine never missing a deadline again, never searching for a lost contract in a folder full of PDFs, and having the full supplier history at your fingertips with one click. That is not a luxury — it is PCONT.
pcont.whatDo: PCONT manages the entire contract lifecycle: from creation and negotiation to digital signature and renewal or termination tracking. No paperwork. No confusion. No headaches.
pcont.forWho: Procurement managers, legal/compliance departments, finance directors, and any organization signing dozens or hundreds of contracts each year.

whyNeed.title: Total Visibility
whyNeed.description: All contracts in one platform. Who signed, when it expires, and which contain critical clauses.

whyNeed.title: Automatic Alerts
whyNeed.description: Never miss a renewal again. The system warns you before the deadline expires.

whyNeed.title: Digital Signature
whyNeed.description: Sign and send contracts in minutes without printing, scanning, or mailing.

whyNeed.title: Full Control
whyNeed.description: Complete history of changes, approvals, and communications related to each contract.

whyNeed.title: Guaranteed Compliance
whyNeed.description: Integrated legal compliance for each contract type.

pcont.slogan: Contract management is no longer chaos. With PCONT, it becomes a competitive advantage.

pcom.title: PCOM
pcom.headline: Your Compliance Officer Will Finally Say “Yes!”
pcom.desc: Tired of endless spreadsheets, disorganized reports, and the constant feeling that something might be out of compliance? PCOM exists to give your Compliance Officer — and the entire leadership team — the visibility and control the market demands.
pcom.whatDo: PCOM is an integrated Compliance management platform that centralizes policies, procedures, risks, controls, audits, and regulatory reporting. From onboarding to continuous compliance monitoring, everything happens in one secure and auditable environment.
pcom.forWho: Management, compliance, audit, risk, and any organization with regulatory requirements and a need for traceability.

whyNeed.title: Centralized Policy Management
whyNeed.description: Create, distribute, track, and confirm acceptance of internal policies without paper.

whyNeed.title: Dynamic Risk Matrix
whyNeed.description: Map, assess, and monitor compliance risks in real time.

whyNeed.title: Audit Management
whyNeed.description: Schedule audits, assign owners, track findings, and action plans.

whyNeed.title: Automatic Reports
whyNeed.description: Reports ready for regulators, boards, and risk committees.

whyNeed.title: Training Management
whyNeed.description: Track mandatory compliance training for all employees.

whyNeed.title: Smart Alerts
whyNeed.description: The platform alerts you when compliance deadlines or pending actions are due.

pcom.slogan: PCOM not only reduces fines and litigation, but also protects the reputation and sustainability of your operations and business.

pm.title: PM
pm.headline: Every Asset Under Control. Every Process Optimized.
pm.desc: From the field to the roof, from warehouse to fleet, from building to equipment — your company's assets need to be managed with rigor. PM does that and much more. All in one place.
pm.whatDo: The Logistics, Asset, and Maintenance Platform is the complete solution for managing your organization's physical assets. It controls inventory, logistics, preventive and corrective maintenance, space management, and much more.
pm.forWho: Companies with physical assets, multiple locations, logistics operations, and the need for rigorous operational maintenance.

whyNeed.title: 360° Asset Visibility
whyNeed.description: You know exactly what you have, where it is, and under what conditions.

whyNeed.title: Fewer Failures, Lower Costs
whyNeed.description: Preventive maintenance reduces unexpected downtime by up to 60%.

whyNeed.title: Inventory Optimization
whyNeed.description: Avoid both shortages and excess inventory.

whyNeed.title: Data-Driven Decisions
whyNeed.description: Reports on asset usage, maintenance costs, and lifecycle.

pm.slogan: Stop managing assets with guesswork. PM is your operational cockpit with real data.

pih.title: PIH
pih.headline: The Future of Hospital Management. Now.
pih.desc: Hospitals and clinics operating with disorganized processes put lives at risk. PIH was built to give healthcare institutions the technology professionals need: operational efficiency, patient safety, and full integration of services.
pih.whatDo: The Integrated Hospital Platform connects all departments and processes of a healthcare institution. From inpatient and outpatient management to the operating room, pharmacy, laboratory, and administration — everything in one interoperable platform.
pih.forWho: Hospitals, clinics, and healthcare networks with needs for clinical workflow, patient management, and operational safety.

whyNeed.title: Patient Safety First
whyNeed.description: Medication interaction alerts, allergies, and automated clinical validation.

whyNeed.title: Information Always Available
whyNeed.description: A single clinical record accessible to all authorized professionals.

whyNeed.title: Reduced Medical Errors
whyNeed.description: Digitalizing processes reduces prescription and identification errors.

whyNeed.title: Operational Efficiency
whyNeed.description: Less paperwork, more time for the patient.

whyNeed.title: Lower Consumables Costs
whyNeed.description: Strict control of pharmacy, stock, and dispensing reduces waste.

whyNeed.title: Integration with Hospital Equipment
whyNeed.description: Direct integration with monitors, infusion pumps, laboratory systems, and imaging equipment.

pih.slogan: Every minute saved in administration is another minute for the patient. PIH returns time to healthcare professionals.

p2p.title: P2P
p2p.headline: Smart Purchasing. Real Savings.
p2p.desc: Slow purchasing processes, blocked approvals, poorly controlled suppliers, invoices nobody knows where they are — these are the pains P2P solves. The Procurement Platform transforms the full acquisition cycle into a fast, transparent, and financially intelligent experience.
p2p.whatDo: P2P covers the full Source-to-Pay cycle: from purchase requisition and approval to supplier negotiation and management, goods receipt, and invoice processing. Purchases become centralized, controlled, and optimized.
p2p.forWho: Organizations with high purchase volumes and a need for financial control, compliance, and operational efficiency.

whyNeed.title: Spending Control
whyNeed.description: Full visibility of what is purchased, when, by whom, and for how much.

whyNeed.title: Faster Processes
whyNeed.description: Requests and approvals that used to take days now take minutes.

whyNeed.title: Measurable Savings
whyNeed.description: Centralized negotiation generates real, measurable savings.

whyNeed.title: Less Errors and Fraud
whyNeed.description: Three-way approval workflows eliminate purchases outside the process.

p2p.slogan: The best purchase is not the cheapest. It is the one that was right from the start. P2P ensures that in every process.

tickets.title: TICKETS
tickets.headline: Problem Solved. Quickly.
tickets.desc: An office flood, a light that does not turn on in reception, the air conditioning that stopped — who solves it? With the Tickets platform, everything arrives, is assigned, and resolved with speed and full traceability.
tickets.whatDo: An integrated ticket management platform for property maintenance and IT HelpDesk. Employees report incidents, the system assigns them automatically, technicians execute tasks, and management has full visibility.
tickets.forWho: Organizations with internal services, property maintenance needs, and operational traceability requirements.

whyNeed.title: Reduced Resolution Time
whyNeed.description: Automatic assignment and SLA monitoring ensure nothing remains unresolved.

whyNeed.title: Visibility for Management
whyNeed.description: Dashboards show open, in-progress, and resolved tickets in real time.

whyNeed.title: Complete History
whyNeed.description: Each property, equipment, or user has its own intervention history.

whyNeed.title: Vendor Evaluation
whyNeed.description: Rate technicians and suppliers and make data-driven decisions.

tickets.slogan: The ticket that does not get lost. The problem that gets resolved. The service that is measured. All in the same platform.

pap.title: PAP
pap.headline: Deliver Projects On Time. Every Time.
pap.desc: Missed targets, endless status meetings without real information, overloaded resources, and late deliveries — if this sounds familiar, PAP is the change your organization needs.
pap.whatDo: The Project Automation Platform allows you to plan, execute, monitor, and report projects in a structured and automated way. From small team projects to multi-project programs with complex governance.
pap.forWho: PMOs, project managers, and teams handling multiple programs or critical deliveries.

whyNeed.title: Real Visibility
whyNeed.description: Management always knows the state of projects without needing status meetings.

whyNeed.title: Less Administrative Work
whyNeed.description: Automation handles notifications, reports, and reminders.

whyNeed.title: Informed Decisions
whyNeed.description: Indicators like SPI and CPI show the real health of projects.

whyNeed.title: Scalable Governance
whyNeed.description: PMOs gain tools to manage dozens of projects at once.

pap.slogan: The biggest project risk is not failing. It is not knowing you are failing until it is too late. PAP ensures that never happens.

piom.title: PIOM
piom.headline: The Integrated Platform for Mining Operations
piom.desc: PIOM brings together all critical processes of a mining operation in a single platform. From document management, logistics, assets, and maintenance to operational control, supervision, procurement, and statistics, everything works in an integrated way to increase efficiency, reduce costs, and support data-driven decisions.
piom.whatDo: The Integrated Platform for Mining Operations (PIOM) centralizes and automates all operational management for mining companies. Its modules communicate with each other, enabling real-time monitoring of equipment, teams, production, contracts, maintenance, logistics, documentation, operational indicators, and integrations with external systems such as ERP, SCADA, GPS, and IoT sensors.
piom.forWho: Mining operations that need integration between production, maintenance, logistics, contracts, and inspections.

whyNeed.title: Fully Integrated Operations
whyNeed.description: All departments work on the same platform, eliminating information silos.

whyNeed.title: Data-Driven Decisions
whyNeed.description: Dashboards and statistical indicators enable real-time operational monitoring.

whyNeed.title: Operational Automation
whyNeed.description: Automates processes, reduces manual tasks, and improves team productivity.

whyNeed.title: Integration with Equipment
whyNeed.description: Communication with sensors, GPS, SCADA/MES systems, and ERP for automatic data collection.

whyNeed.title: Compliance with International Standards
whyNeed.description: Developed according to ISO/IEC standards and mining-sector regulatory requirements.

whyNeed.title: Scalability
whyNeed.description: Adaptable to small, medium, or large mining operations through complete parametrization.

piom.slogan: One platform. The entire mining operation under control.
